title: Introduction, Pallet Town
question: How do I start the game from the title screen?
answer: Press the A Button or Start on the title screen after the brief cutscene.

title: Introduction, Pallet Town
question: How do I name the rival character?
answer: You can choose the rival's name from a list of preset names or select a new one.

title: Introduction, Pallet Town
question: Where can I find Route 21 from Pallet Town?
answer: Route 21 can be accessed via the waters to the south of town.
